categories.label: Cheese
categories.help: Cheese goods tiles you own (2 points each).

categories.label: Grain
categories.help: Grain goods tiles you own (1 point each).

categories.label: Trading stations and citizens
categories.help: Add your built trading stations to your collected citizen tiles (include the leftover citizen tile if you won it), then multiply by your development status. Enter the result.

categories.label: Development track position
categories.help: How far along the development track your marker is. Scores nothing; the player further ahead wins a tie.

notes: Base game only; expansions (Trade & Intrigue, The Plague, Stories) and the optional place-tile exclusion rule are out of scope. Rounds are 18 but entries are single end-of-game values, so rounds is 18 for reference only. Read from a retailer-hosted copy (1jour-1jeu CDN) of the publisher PDF, not from dlp games directly. Supported players 2 to 4 taken from the rulebook's 2, 3 and 4 player setup rules. The development position is the track space reached; compare the marker positions on the board.
